BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Order under Section 38 (a) of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,No. 1200/06,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.07th February 2024.
SCHEDULE
1. Acquiring Oﬃ cer.– Divisional Secretary, Galewela.

2. Description of the land.– An allotment of land morefully described in below name and extent in the Final Village Plan No. 335, Supplementary No. 31, SheetNo. 22 and dated 05.09.2018, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Andagala in the Grama Niladhari Division No. E 431 A of Hombawa in the Minor Divison of Kandapalla Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Galewela in Matale District of the Central Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot No. 1337 – Bulugahamulayaya – Extent: 0.0219 Hectare North: Lot Nos. 1316, 1336 and 1333; East: Lot Nos. 1333 and 1334; South: Lot Nos. 1335 and 1338; West: Lot Nos. 1338 and 1314.
